hunks.baseline: For a moment, it felt as though the world had stopped.
hunks.sol: For a moment, the world seemed to stop.

hunks.baseline: The hundreds of people staring at me with their mouths hanging open. The cameras and microphones poking up between them. The dazzling lights illuminating the wide-open lot instead of the moonlight.
hunks.sol: The hundreds of people staring at me with their mouths open. The cameras and microphones jutting up between them. The dazzling lights illuminating the broad lot in place of moonlight.

hunks.baseline: Everything around me grew slower and blurred at the same time.
hunks.sol: Everything around me slowed and blurred.

hunks.baseline: Everything except the one person who had brought my world to a halt.
hunks.sol: Everything except the one man who had brought my world to a halt.

hunks.baseline: An unscrupulous schemer unlike anyone I had ever seen was staring at me.
hunks.sol: The most cunning, unscrupulous man I had ever met stared back at me.

hunks.baseline: His eyes, always calm and subdued, now held unmistakable laughter and triumph. The voice that once again burrowed into my ears was perfectly clear.
hunks.sol: His eyes, usually so calm, held unmistakable amusement and triumph. His voice came through just as clearly when it reached my ears again.

hunks.baseline: —You seem rather surprised.
hunks.sol: —You seem surprised.

hunks.baseline: I came to my senses at those words and belatedly steadied my breathing.
hunks.sol: I came to my senses and belatedly steadied my breathing.

hunks.baseline: No matter what he said, I could not let him see me shaken.
hunks.sol: Whatever he said, I couldn’t let him see me shaken.

hunks.baseline: The moment I showed an opening to an enemy, my weakness would be exposed. And when that enemy was Michael Silbert, I had to be even more careful.
hunks.sol: Show an enemy an opening, and he’d find your weakness. I needed to be especially careful when that enemy was Michael Silbert.

hunks.baseline: *It’s not too late. As far as I know, the Skeleton King’s identity is perfectly secure, and he still hasn’t produced any evidence.*
hunks.sol: *It’s not too late. As far as I know, the Skeleton King’s identity is secure, and he hasn’t shown me any proof.*

hunks.baseline: I had to keep my composure from this point onward. If I could respond properly without being rattled by whatever he said next…
hunks.sol: I had to stay calm from here on out. Whatever he said next, all I had to do was answer without letting it rattle me…

hunks.baseline: The sound of bones shifting rang out from my tightly clenched fist.
hunks.sol: Bones shifted audibly in my clenched fist.

hunks.baseline: No matter how much I reassured myself, it was already too late. From the moment my eyes met his gray ones, my instincts had been screaming.
hunks.sol: I could tell myself whatever I wanted. It was already too late. From the moment I’d met his gray eyes, my instincts had been screaming that his remark wasn’t a mere probe.

hunks.baseline: That his previous remark had not been a simple probe.
That Michael Silbert had not come here with a guess, but with certainty.
hunks.sol: Michael Silbert had come here certain, not guessing.

hunks.baseline: And the voice that followed put a period at the end of that thought.
hunks.sol: His next words settled it.

hunks.baseline: —You have two choices now. Ah, of course, you don’t really have much of a choice, but listening to them for fun shouldn’t be too bad.
hunks.sol: —You have two choices. Of course, you don’t have much choice at all, but you might as well hear them for the fun of it.

hunks.baseline: His tone and voice were relaxed. With his back to the cameras, Michael Silbert moved his lips with a more pleased expression than ever.
hunks.sol: His voice was relaxed. With his back to the cameras, Michael moved his lips, looking more pleased than I had ever seen him.

hunks.baseline: —The first is that your friend’s identity is revealed in front of the entire world. The second is that you leave this noisy place and have a private conversation with me, just the two of us.
hunks.sol: —First, your friend’s identity is exposed before the entire world. Second, you leave this noisy place, and the two of us have a private talk.

hunks.baseline: —So, what will you do?
hunks.sol: —So? What will it be?

hunks.baseline: *Damn it.*
hunks.sol: “Damn it.”

hunks.baseline: At the curse that slipped out in a whisper, the bastard gave me a faint smile and approached.
hunks.sol: The curse slipped out in a whisper. Michael gave me a faint smile and stepped closer.

hunks.baseline: Just as his slowly extended hand brushed the dried blood and dust from my shoulder, the reporters who had finally come to their senses belatedly released the shouts they had been holding back.
hunks.sol: His hand reached out slowly and brushed the dried blood and dust from my shoulder. At last, the reporters came to their senses and let loose the shouts they had been holding back.

hunks.baseline: “Mr. Jin Taekyung! Did your statement just now mean that you oppose the World Hunter Federation?”
hunks.sol: “Mr. Jin Taekyung! Does what you just said mean you oppose the World Hunter Federation?”

hunks.baseline: “W-Wait! Please tell us the exact meaning of your profanity!”
hunks.sol: “W-Wait! Please tell us exactly what you meant by that profanity!”

hunks.baseline: Flashes erupted from every direction as the cameras kept rolling.
hunks.sol: The cameras kept rolling as flashes burst from every direction.

hunks.baseline: Amid the waves of noise pouring out as the dam of silence collapsed, Michael Silbert quietly raised a hand to calm the crowd before speaking.
hunks.sol: The dam of silence broke, releasing a wave of noise. Michael quietly raised a hand to settle the crowd, then spoke.

hunks.sol: “My friend here is already a hero the whole world is watching. He is also a spirited young man. The battles and events of recent days must have exhausted him, so I ask for your understanding.”

hunks.sol: “I’m sorry, but let’s leave that discussion for another time. There is only one thing I came to tell you today.”

hunks.sol: Michael looked into the cameras.

hunks.baseline: “That is all. I hope you all have a pleasant evening.”
hunks.sol: “That is all. Have a good night, everyone.”

hunks.baseline: Those were his final words.

hunks.baseline: Along with a short remark only I could hear.

hunks.baseline: —I’ll be making coffee for you, so I hope you won’t be late.
hunks.sol: —I’ll make you some coffee. I hope you won’t keep me waiting.

hunks.baseline: My teeth clenched on their own.
hunks.sol: My teeth clenched.

hunks.baseline: I already knew why he had left me those words.
hunks.sol: I knew why he’d said it.

hunks.baseline: “Mr. Jin Taekyung! Please, just give us a statement!”
hunks.sol: “Mr. Jin Taekyung! Please, just one statement!”

hunks.baseline: As I turned away from the cameras as though fleeing, I saw two figures rapidly approaching.
hunks.sol: I turned away from the cameras as though fleeing and saw two figures hurrying toward me.

hunks.baseline: Their expressions were mixed with confusion and shock, and their voices were low enough for only me to hear.
hunks.sol: Confusion and shock were written across their faces. They spoke too quietly for anyone else to hear.

hunks.baseline: “Damn it, what the hell is this mess? What’s this World Hunter Federation thing, anyway?”
hunks.sol: “Fuck, what the hell is going on? And what’s this World Hunter Federation?”

hunks.baseline: I remained silent despite the two of them firing off their words like rapid gunshots.
hunks.sol: Their questions came in a rush, but I said nothing.

hunks.baseline: *What should I say?*
hunks.sol: *What could I say?*

hunks.baseline: *Where should I even begin, and how should I explain it?*
hunks.sol: *Where would I even begin?*

hunks.baseline: After wrestling with all those questions, one person’s face suddenly came to mind.
hunks.sol: As I wrestled with that, someone’s face came to mind.

hunks.baseline: At the name that abruptly slipped out, the Skeleton King frowned.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King frowned at the name.

hunks.baseline: “Why are you suddenly bringing up that man? Before that, what exactly is going on here… Wait, is there something on my face?”
hunks.sol: “Why bring him up all of a sudden? First, tell me what’s going on… Wait. Is there something on my face?”

hunks.baseline: I had been staring blankly at his face without even realizing it. I shook my head.
hunks.sol: I’d been staring at him without realizing it. I shook my head.

hunks.baseline: “……No. Nothing at all.”
hunks.sol: “…No. Nothing.”

hunks.baseline: I still was not certain.
Whether I should tell him what had just happened. What choice I—or we—should make.
hunks.sol: I still didn’t know whether to tell him what had just happened. Or what choice I—what choice *we*—should make.

hunks.baseline: But some emotions could not be hidden simply because one wanted to hide them.
hunks.sol: But some feelings couldn’t be hidden just because you wanted to hide them.

hunks.baseline: Only then did Team Leader Choi belatedly realize that something was concealed beneath the surface. His face hardened, and his lips moved.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi finally realized I was keeping something from them. His face hardened, and his lips moved.

hunks.baseline: —What is it? What happened for you to suddenly ask for Mr. Johnson?
hunks.sol: —What is it? What happened that made you ask for Mr. Johnson?

hunks.baseline: The thoughts tangled inside my head were long, but their wait was short.
hunks.sol: My thoughts were tangled, but they didn’t have long to wait.

hunks.baseline: After several dozen seconds that felt like an hour, I sent my voice toward Team Leader Choi through Sound Transmission.
hunks.sol: After several dozen seconds that felt like an hour, I sent Choi a Sound Transmission.

hunks.sol: The first thing I saw when I entered his private aircraft, as spacious as a suite, was a cup of coffee on the table.

hunks.baseline: I did not bother to respond. Instead, I took my eyes off the cup and jerked my chin toward Michael Silbert.

hunks.baseline: That was a secret no one in this world could even guess at, and a weapon that would one day become a dagger driven into an enemy’s heart.
